integrity: Reproducible exact arithmetic in the complete cyclotomic quotient and full finite orbit enumeration. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification on the standard all-plus rational Fermat quartic in characteristic zero; 12-sets are maximum cardinality and their fields refer to the unordered reduced union, not individually defined lines. An arithmetic statement about sign-twisted models is not asserted. Historical/unindexed overlap remains possible.
title: Maximal skew-line systems of the Fermat quartic: geometric and arithmetic orbit classification
